Project Brief – Quartermass Studio Website Refresh

Quartermass Studio is an independent design studio based in Glasgow, founded 2018, partner-led, four full-time designers, two long-standing freelance collaborators. Practice spans brand identity, editorial design, packaging, and motion. Clients include independent record labels, university presses, two contemporary art galleries, and a small but growing roster of B2B SaaS companies (we know — but they pay).

we don't do logos as a deliverable. we do brand systems, which we consider a real distinction. we don't do "thought leadership content." we don't write SEO pages. when prospective clients ask if we can ghostwrite their LinkedIn we politely decline.

studio principles:
- One project at a time per designer. We don't multitask creative work, ever.
- All work is partner-supervised. Junior designers aren't running client meetings alone.
- We bill a fixed project fee disclosed at kick-off. No hourly billing, no scope creep invoices.
- We publish process documentation for every project. Public unless the client objects.

Recent recognition: shortlisted Brand New 2024 (twice), D&AD wood pencil 2024, Type Directors Club merit 2023.

Why we exist (this is the bit i wrote drunk at 1am, edit it): we got tired of the agency model where the partner pitches and the juniors deliver. we built a studio where the partners do the work. it's slower, smaller, more selective. we don't grow on purpose.

Voice we want on the site: dry. Slightly arch. References to type history are fine, even welcome, as long as they're not pretentious. Sentences should be short. Long sentences should be deliberately long. No "we believe that great design..." anything.

Pricing — premium. Brand systems start at £45k. We turn down ~60% of inbounds either on fit or capacity.

Site sections: index page, work (case studies, ~12), studio (about + team + recognition), notes (blog/process), contact + new business inquiries. We don't need a "services" page in the listing sense.

Contact: hi@quartermass.studio.
